title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
summary: Both sides share confidential information and promise to keep it private.
useWhen: Two companies or people will trade sensitive details before a deal, a hire or a partnership.
watchOuts: Name the purpose narrowly; a broad purpose weakens the promise.
Check how long confidentiality lasts after the agreement ends.
Trade secrets may need protection for longer than the term.

variables.label: First party's legal name
variables.help: A person's full name or a company's registered name.

variables.label: Purpose
variables.default: evaluating a possible business relationship between the parties
variables.help: Why the parties are sharing information.

sections.title: 1. Parties and Purpose
sections.body: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the **Agreement**) is made on {{effective_date}} between {{party_a_name}} and {{party_b_name}} (each a **Party**). The Parties want to share information for the purpose of {{purpose}} (the **Purpose**).

sections.title: 2. Confidential Information
3. Obligations
sections.body: Each Party will use the other's Confidential Information only for the Purpose, protect it with at least reasonable care, and share it only with employees and advisers who need to know it and are bound by similar duties. A Party may disclose Confidential Information when the law requires it, after giving the other Party prompt notice where allowed.

sections.title: 4. Term
sections.body: This Agreement lasts for {{term_years}} years from the effective date. Duties of confidentiality survive for {{term_years}} years after it ends, and for trade secrets, for as long as the information stays a trade secret.

sections.title: 5. Non-Solicitation
sections.body: During the term and for one year after, neither Party will directly solicit for employment any employee of the other Party it met through the Purpose. General job advertisements are not solicitation.

sections.title: 6. Remedies
sections.body:
Unauthorized disclosure may cause harm that money cannot fully repair, so either Party may seek an injunction in addition to any other remedy. *Agreed liquidated damages, if any:* {{penalty}}.

Initials of each Party: [[initial:partyA]] [[initial:partyB]]

sections.title: 7. Governing Law
sections.body: The laws of the State of {{governing_state}} govern this Agreement, without regard to its conflict of laws rules.

sections.title: 8. Signatures
sections.body:
Each Party signs below to show it agrees to this Agreement.

**{{party_a_name}}**
[[sig:partyA]] [[date:partyA]]
[[name:partyA]] [[text:partyA:Title]]

**{{party_b_name}}**
[[sig:partyB]] [[date:partyB]]
[[name:partyB]] [[text:partyB:Title]]

disclaimer: This template is a starting point, not legal advice. Laws differ by state and situation. Have a lawyer review it before you rely on it.
